title: Circuit Builder
description: Wire up real working circuits with cells, switches, bulbs, LEDs, motors, buzzers and fuses. Learn series and parallel, Ohm's law and short circuits, then power the houses of Brick Town.
controls: Click a part on the left, tap the board to place it, drag dot to dot for wires; Hand tool flips and switches, Meter measures (1-9 pick tools, H hint, R restart)
